a: لَكَ يَنْبَغِي التَّسْبِيحُ يَا اَللهُ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ، وَلَكَ يُوفَى النَّذْرُ.
e: Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

a: يَا سَامِعَ الصَّلاَةِ، إِلَيْكَ يَأْتِي كُلُّ بَشَرٍ.
e: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.

a: آثامٌ قَدْ قَوِيَتْ عَلَيَّ. مَعَاصِينَا أَنْتَ تُكَفِّرُ عَنْهَا.
e: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

a: طُوبَى لِلَّذِي تَخْتَارُهُ وَتُقَرِّبُهُ لِيَسْكُنَ فِي دِيَارِكَ. لَنَشْبَعَنَّ مِنْ خَيْرِ بَيْتِكَ، قُدْسِ هَيْكَلِكَ.
e: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

a: بِمَخَاوِفَ فِي الْعَدْلِ تَسْتَجِيبُنَا يَا إِلهَ خَلاَصِنَا، يَا مُتَّكَلَ جَمِيعِ أَقَاصِي الأَرْضِ وَالْبَحْرِ الْبَعِيدَةِ.
e: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:
Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

a: الْمُهْدِّئُ عَجِيجَ الْبِحَارِ، عَجِيجَ أَمْوَاجِهَا، وَضَجِيجَ الأُمَمِ.
e: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

a: وَتَخَافُ سُكَّانُ الأَقَاصِي مِنْ آيَاتِكَ. تَجْعَلُ مَطَالِعَ الصَّبَاحِ وَالْمَسَاءِ تَبْتَهِجُ.
e: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

a: تَعَهَّدْتَ الأَرْضَ وَجَعَلْتَهَا تَفِيضُ. تُغْنِيهَا جِدًّا. سَوَاقِي اللهِ مَلآنَةٌ مَاءً. تُهَيِّئُ طَعَامَهُمْ لأَنَّكَ هكَذَا تُعِدُّهَا.
e: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

a: أَرْوِ أَتْلاَمَهَا. مَهِّدْ أَخَادِيدَهَا. بِالْغُيُوثِ تُحَلِّلُهَا. تُبَارِكُ غَلَّتَهَا.
e: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

a: كَلَّلْتَ السَّنَةَ بِجُودِكَ، وَآثارُكَ تَقْطُرُ دَسَمًا.
e: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

a: تَقْطُرُ مَرَاعِي الْبَرِّيَّةِ، وَتَتَنَطَّقُ الآكَامُ بِالْبَهْجَةِ.
e: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

a: اكْتَسَتِ الْمُرُوجُ غَنَمًا، وَالأَوْدِيَةُ تَتَعَطَّفُ بُرًّا. تَهْتِفُ وَأَيْضًا تُغَنِّي.
e: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
